say:2:1211328002:1.text: I need more data! That skirmish wasn't enough to measure your true potential.
say:2:1211328002:1.source_cn: 我需要更多实验数据……！这场战斗还测不出你们力量的上限……
say:2:1211328002:1.male: I need more data! That skirmish wasn't enough to measure your true potential.
say:2:1211328002:1.female: I need more data! That skirmish wasn't enough to measure your true potential.

say:4:1211328003:1.text: Viperian, what are you doing?! Capture them now!
say:4:1211328003:1.source_cn: 维珀，你在想什么，趁现在拿下他们！

say:5:1211328004:1.text: Fear not, I will secure them later. These are prime specimens for our experiments.
say:5:1211328004:1.source_cn: 会的，会的，但不是现在，我要拿最好的实验品招待他们。

say:6:1211328005:1.text: You are all fascinating subjects indeed... <style="highlight">We'll meet again on the Immortal</style>.
